findings.title: PowerShell Execution Environment Issue
findings.description: Windows PowerShell environment has fundamental execution issues preventing command execution. Commands like 'flutter --version', 'flutter pub get', 'flutter analyze', 'flutter test', and 'flutter build apk' cannot be executed due to environmental constraints.
findings.impact: Cannot run real-time verification of tests, lint analysis, and APK builds on current system.
findings.resolution: Requires execution in a proper Flutter development environment (Linux VM, macOS, or Windows with proper shell configuration).

code_review_findings.details: Project is well-organized with clear separation of concerns: models, services (calculation, storage, appliance), providers (AppState), screens, widgets, and theme. All 9 planned features appear to be implemented.
